original_claim: Fat cross-cohort consensus programme of 1,408 genes (Tier B) exists
corrected_wording: No cross-cohort adipose consensus can be claimed: the 1,408-gene set has FDR support in GSE135917 only (0 of 1,408 genes are FDR-significant in GSE38792); it is reclassified as a GSE135917 single-cohort gene set.

original_claim: Fat programme (FAT set) CPAP response: no significant change in GSE135917 paired arms
verdict_after_exclusion: STANDS (trivially — the set it tests no longer exists as a consensus; the null result itself is unchanged)
corrected_wording: The FAT-set score does not change with CPAP within GSE135917 (Step 3 result unchanged); the set must be cited as a single-cohort set, not a consensus programme.

original_claim: GSE135917 disease contrast yields 9,455 FDR genes (47.3% of transcriptome), median logFC -0.134
verdict_after_exclusion: STANDS as a within-cohort fact, WITH the global-shift caveat permanently attached
corrected_wording: Report only together with: the contrast is dominated by a transcriptome-wide shift (median logFC -0.134); gene-level interpretation is not supported.

verdict_after_exclusion: DOWNGRADED to single-cohort exploratory observation under the global-shift caveat
corrected_wording: WGCNA modules are reported as exploratory, single-cohort, and potentially reflecting the global shift / cell-composition differences rather than an OSA programme.

original_claim: GSE38792 (visceral fat, 10 CPAP vs 9 no-CPAP) carries no disease FDR signal
verdict_after_exclusion: STANDS (unaffected — it is the surviving cohort)
corrected_wording: GSE38792 provides nominal-level signal only (2,138 genes); it is the sole uncontaminated adipose cohort and supports no FDR claim alone.

original_claim: Adipose tissue participates in the OSA programme at cross-cohort level
verdict_after_exclusion: RETRACTED at FDR calibre; adipose evidence is single-cohort and shift-confounded
corrected_wording: All adipose-layer statements in the manuscript must be single-cohort calibre (GSE135917, shift-caveated) or nominal calibre (GSE38792).
